faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Forensic reconstruction of a YouTube viewing history tracking radicalization.
kurzfassung: Journalists analyze four years of a young man's YouTube viewing history to understand how internet recommendation algorithms and alternative media personalities shaped his radicalization. Starting from pop culture parodies and video game controversies, his watch habits evolved through provocative commentators toward white nationalist ideology. The investigation reveals how heavy consumption and algorithmic rabbit holes transformed his worldview step by step.
stichpunkte: Analysis of 12,000 videos across four years of a viewer's YouTube history
Origins in the Gamergate controversy and anti-progressive commentary
Role of algorithmic recommendations in driving deeper into alternative media
Emergence of a new political identity focused on anti-establishment narratives
Transition from cultural grievances to figures like Stefan Molyneux and Milo Yiannopoulos
Influence of workplace environments on continuous listening habits and increased watch time
Progression toward radical viewpoints including race realism and the great replacement theory
Reflections on how alternative media figures surpassed mainstream organizations in reach
